Package com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.out.persistence

Class KfeChannelCapacityQueueService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.out.persistence.KfeChannelCapacityQueueService
@Service public class KfeChannelCapacityQueueService extends Object
Durable queue for dead-man capacity intents (OPEN / CLOSE). Binary AND gates are re-evaluated at execution time by the worker.

  • Method Details

    • enqueueOpenIfAbsent

      @Transactional public Optional<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity> enqueueOpenIfAbsent(String peerPubkey, long localAmountSats, long estimatedCostSats, long expectedGainSats, String triggerReason, UUID decisionId)
      Enqueues one OPEN intent per peer among PENDING/IN_PROGRESS jobs after checking the profit wallet can cover the estimated structural cost. Values are clamped nonnegative and trigger text is capped; a uniqueness race reloads the existing live intent.
      Parameters:
      peerPubkey - target peer public key
      localAmountSats - desired local channel capacity
      estimatedCostSats - expected structural cost to admit against available SYSTEM_PROFIT funds
      expectedGainSats - expected economic gain recorded for worker policy
      triggerReason - signal or administrative reason, truncated to the entity column limit
      decisionId - persisted lifecycle decision associated with this queue item
      Returns:
      existing active intent or newly persisted job; empty when available profit is insufficient

    • enqueueCloseIfAbsent

      @Transactional public Optional<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity> enqueueCloseIfAbsent(String channelPoint, String peerPubkey, long estimatedCostSats, String triggerReason, UUID decisionId)
      Enqueues one CLOSE intent per channel point among PENDING/IN_PROGRESS jobs. Close jobs retain the associated peer and decision but do not perform the OPEN-specific available-profit admission check.
      Parameters:
      channelPoint - exact channel point to close
      peerPubkey - remote peer public key, if known
      estimatedCostSats - estimated structural close cost, clamped nonnegative
      triggerReason - inactive-channel or administrative trigger, truncated to column length
      decisionId - persisted lifecycle close decision
      Returns:
      existing active intent or newly persisted job
